sections.title: Identification and range
sections.text: Heller's prickly pear is a branching cactus endemic to several northern Galápagos Islands. POWO treats Opuntia helleri as a synonym of O. galapageia var. helleri, while the Charles Darwin Foundation retains O. helleri at species rank.

sections.title: Pads, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The cactus bears flattened cladodes, spiny areoles and yellow flowers. The plate shows a yellow-green fruit; its ripe colour could not be verified specifically for this taxon.

sections.title: Edibility and conservation
sections.text: Wildlife consumption of the fruit is reported, but no human food use specific to this species was verified. The Charles Darwin Foundation classifies the species as Vulnerable.
